effects.does: Clicking it opens Clara to help generate or edit event content.
effects.affects: It may add AI-generated content to the event when line items are available.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara panel opens.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the attachment control for adding files to the event.
effects.affects: It changes the event's attachment data if files are selected.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that an attachment picker or upload control appears.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.affects: It changes the event's terms-and-conditions record when clauses or attachments are saved.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms-and-conditions editor opens.

effects.does: Clicking it starts publishing the auction after required validations and confirmation.
effects.affects: It changes the event from draft creation into the publish flow and can create or send the event.
effects.leadsTo: Publish confirmation dialog or the created event state
effects.check: Click Publish and verify that validation or the publish confirmation appears.

effects.does: Clicking it selects ranking by lot for the auction.
effects.affects: It changes the auction strategy and lot-based closing configuration.
effects.check: Click Rank on lot and verify that the lot-ranking option becomes selected.

effects.does: It is disabled, so clicking it does nothing; the screen does not expose the reason.
effects.affects: Nothing.
effects.check: Verify that Buy Template is visibly disabled and cannot be activated.

effects.does: Clicking it opens controls for adding columns to the event table.
effects.affects: It changes the columns displayed in the event data grid if new columns are selected.
effects.check: Click Add Columns and verify that column options are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the event details section or drawer.
effects.affects: It changes only the visible event-details view.
effects.check: Click Details and verify that event detail fields are shown.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the price-components configuration.
effects.affects: It changes the price-component fields used for bid entry when saved.
effects.check: Click Price Components and verify that price-component settings appear.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the participant-management view.
effects.affects: It changes the event's invited participant records when vendors are added or removed.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that invited vendors and participant controls are shown.

effects.does: Clicking the vendor button selects or opens the listed vendor participant.
effects.affects: It may change the event's selected or invited vendor record.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here or a vendor detail view
effects.check: Click the vendor control and verify whether the vendor becomes selected or its details open.

effects.does: Clicking it clears the current participant search or selection.
effects.affects: It removes the current search or selection from the participant controls.
effects.check: Enter a vendor search, click Clear, and verify that the search or selection is removed.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the savings configuration or summary.
effects.affects: It changes or displays the event's savings data and related configuration.
effects.check: Click Savings and verify that savings details or settings appear.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms-and-conditions view.
effects.affects: It changes the event's terms-and-conditions record when edits are saved.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or section
effects.check: Click Terms & Conditions and verify that the configured clauses or attachments are shown.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the auction schedule editor for the current start and end timing.
effects.affects: It changes the stage schedule, including the duration or end time, when saved.
effects.check: Click the time button and verify that the schedule drawer shows the current 30-minute timing.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the feedback submission interface.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event unless feedback is submitted separately.
effects.check: Click Give Feedback and verify that a feedback form opens.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the support-ticket view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event.
effects.check: Click View Tickets and verify that the tickets view opens.

effects.does: Clicking the selected Auction tab displays the auction stage.
effects.affects: It changes only the visible stage view.
effects.check: Verify that Auction remains selected and the auction configuration is visible.

effects.does: Clicking it navigates to the Events area.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the Events screen opens.

effects.does: Clicking it navigates to the tickets view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click View Tickets and verify that the tickets screen opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: It is disabled, so the project title cannot be edited on this screen.
effects.affects: The event title remains unchanged and cannot be corrected here.
effects.check: Verify that the title field is disabled and rejects keyboard input.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Selecting a vendor from the search results adds that vendor to the event participants.
effects.affects: It changes the event's audience participant records and the later publish validation.
effects.check: Search for an eligible vendor, select it, and verify that the vendor appears as a participant.

effects.does: It displays the serial-number column header and does not provide an identified edit action.

effects.check: Verify that the S no. header is visible above the line-item rows.

effects.does: It displays the required Product column header for line items.
effects.affects: Product values are part of the required line-item data.
effects.check: Verify that Product is marked required and appears above the line-item rows.

effects.does: It displays the required Product Variant column header for line items.
effects.affects: Product-variant values are part of the line-item data and are locked when applicable.

effects.does: It displays the required Quantity Requested column header.
effects.affects: The requested quantity is part of each line item's data and can constrain later bidding or awarding.

effects.does: It displays the required Delivery location column header.
effects.affects: The line item's delivery-location data is used for the sourcing event.

effects.does: It displays the required Price column header.
effects.affects: The event's bid-price data is captured against this price field.
effects.check: Verify that Price is marked required and is available for bid entry.

effects.does: It displays the required Quantity Available column header.
effects.affects: Available-quantity data is captured for the line item and can be used during awarding.
effects.check: Verify that Quantity Available is marked required in the line-item table.

effects.does: It displays the GST column header for tax values.
effects.affects: GST data is included with the line-item pricing information when provided.
effects.check: Verify that GST is visible as a column in the line-item table.

effects.does: Lets the buyer enter the required total amount for the line item.
effects.affects: Updates the line item's amount data and its validation before the event can proceed.
effects.check: Leave the field empty and verify validation prevents proceeding, then enter a valid amount and verify the error clears.

cases.title: Auction detail sections open from their buttons
cases.expected: Each click opens or selects the section named on the button. The displayed content changes to the corresponding details, price components, or participants section.
gaps: Directly verify that the displayed content changes to the corresponding section rather than only confirming the named section text is visible.

cases.title: Ask Clara starts the AI request when line items exist
cases.expected: The Clara panel or flow opens. A POST request is sent to "/ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions", followed by a GET request to "/external_requests/:uuid".
cases.setup: Open a converted auction containing at least one line item. Enable network inspection.
gaps: Assert the exact Clara panel or flow opened after clicking Ask Clara
